source: manual_synthesis: prototypical AI-generated cover letter. Career-vocabulary tells + sycophancy + vague achievement claims + chatbot opener. Concrete claims (cloud-native experience, monolith → microservices migration, latency / scalability work) must survive any rewrite — metrics + job title + tech stack are sacred. First-person + active voice mandatory in the rewrite.
input:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my profound interest in the Senior Software Engineer position at TechCorp, which I discovered while browsing your career portal. With my comprehensive background in cloud-native architectures and my passionate dedication to crafting innovative solutions, I am uniquely positioned to make meaningful contributions to your dynamic team.

Throughout my career, I have consistently demonstrated a results-driven approach, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver transformative outcomes. In my current role at DataFlow Inc., I led the migration of a monolithic application to microservices over 18 months, reducing p99 latency by 40% and enabling the platform to scale to 3x its previous capacity. My expertise spans a robust range of frameworks including Kubernetes, Go, and PostgreSQL, and I am particularly thrilled by the opportunity to bring my unique blend of technical depth and collaborative spirit to TechCorp's groundbreaking work in real-time data infrastructure.

I am confident that my skills align seamlessly with the requirements outlined in the job description, and I would be honored to discuss how my experience can contribute to your team's continued success. Thank you for considering my application.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Alex Chen
